title: Sharp spherical product-moment bounds for nonzero complex linear forms with proportionality and orthogonality equality cases
author: Frédéric Campana, Lionel Darondeau, Jean-Pierre Demailly and Erwan Rousseau
work: On the existence of logarithmic and orbifold jet differentials
source_version: Official published version, Annales Henri Lebesgue 7 (2024), 10.5802/ahl.197
difficulty_reason: The authors prove a sharp lower bound for the spherical product moment of p non-zero complex linear forms by disintegrating the rotation invariant measure on the sphere, applying Parseval's formula to extract the elementary symmetric functions of the normalised forms, and running an induction through a dense set of normal forms. A separate induction on the dimension determines exactly when the orthogonality equality case is attained, and a Holder argument supplies the matching upper bound with its own proportionality equality case. This is a source-local complex spherical moment estimate with two complete equality classifications, above ordinary qualification analysis.
